name: Recommended Dietary Allowance
description: Reference intake covering the needs of nearly all healthy people in a specified population. It is not a universal minimum or treatment dose.

review.note: Original explanatory summary. This is not scientific review of numeric intake tables.

name: Adequate Intake
description: An intake judged adequate when evidence does not support establishing an RDA. It does not establish an exact individual requirement.

review.note: Original explanatory summary. This is not scientific review of numeric intake tables.

name: Estimated Average Requirement
description: A population requirement estimate covering about half of a specified healthy group. It is not a personal daily intake target.

review.note: Original explanatory summary. This is not scientific review of numeric intake tables.

name: Tolerable Upper Intake Level
description: An upper chronic-intake boundary associated with low adverse-effect risk in its stated population. It is not a goal to reach.

review.note: Original explanatory summary. This is not scientific review of numeric intake tables.

name: Tolerable Upper Limit
description: Upper-limit terminology used by a source framework. Its population and food-versus-supplement scope must accompany the value. It is not an intake goal.

review.note: Original explanatory summary. This is not scientific review of numeric intake tables.

name: Acceptable Macronutrient Distribution Range
description: A population reference range for macronutrient intake, expressed with an explicit energy basis. It does not produce a gram target without energy context.

review.note: Original explanatory summary. This is not scientific review of numeric intake tables.

name: Chronic Disease Risk Reduction Intake
description: An intake reference above which reducing intake is expected to reduce chronic disease risk in the specified population. It is not a toxicity threshold.

review.note: Original explanatory summary. This is not scientific review of numeric intake tables.

name: Daily Value
description: A food-label reference used to express the contribution of a serving. It is distinct from an individual RDA or AI.

review.note: Original explanatory summary. This is not scientific review of numeric intake tables.

name: Population Reference Intake
description: EFSA's reference covering the needs of most people in a specified population. Framework definitions and population must remain visible.

review.note: Original explanatory summary. This is not scientific review of numeric intake tables.

name: Average Requirement
description: EFSA's estimate covering the needs of half of a specified population. It is a population concept, not an individual prescription.

review.note: Original explanatory summary. This is not scientific review of numeric intake tables.

name: Reference Intake range
description: An EFSA reference range used for macronutrients. Its source and percentage-of-energy basis must accompany the range.

review.note: Original explanatory summary. This is not scientific review of numeric intake tables.

name: Retinol activity equivalents
description: A vitamin A equivalence system accounting for differing activity of forms. Retinol and carotenoid amounts cannot be added as though all units were interchangeable.

review.note: Original explanatory summary. This is not scientific review of numeric intake tables.

name: Dietary folate equivalents
description: A folate equivalence system distinguishing food folate and other forms. Conversion requires the source's form and consumption context.

review.note: Original explanatory summary. This is not scientific review of numeric intake tables.

name: Niacin equivalents
description: A reference concept accounting for niacin and its contribution from tryptophan. A composition amount labelled mg cannot automatically be treated as mg NE.

review.note: Original explanatory summary. This is not scientific review of numeric intake tables.
